scoring_justification: Cannot recompute DFT/TD-DFT results in lightweight checker; comparison of reported values with paper gold tolerances and structural consistency checks on transition assignments and NBO interaction strengths.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported gold values for UV-Vis peaks, NBO E2 thresholds, and natural charges
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper; embedded inline as gold tolerances
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper for ferrocene I, used as reference for reproduction.

outputs.description: Two rows with the main absorption peak wavelengths, oscillator strengths, and assigned orbital transitions.
Second-order perturbation energies E(2) for key Fe–Cp donor-acceptor interactions.
Natural atomic charges from NBO analysis.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the molecular DFT part only; solid-state Wien2k calculations (band structure, dielectric function, magnetic moments) are excluded per task scope.

steps.description: Check UV-Vis peak wavelengths and oscillator strengths against paper gold tolerances, and verify transition label consistency.
Verify presence of strong Fe(d)->Cp LP* donation (E2 > 100 kcal/mol) and back-donation entries.
Check natural atomic charges for Fe, C, H, and Cp rings against paper reference with tolerance.
